project_type: Ruby on Rails backend + React/TypeScript frontend (Mastodon fork)
test_framework: RSpec for Ruby, Jest for TypeScript
build_command: bundle exec rails assets:precompile (not feasible in sandbox)
verification_instructions: AST validation - check TypeScript compiles with yarn tsc --noEmit, check Ruby syntax with ruby -c
environment_constraints: Full internet access available. No running database for integration tests. Use AST/syntax validation.
contribution_requirements: Changes on occm-groupdm branch. SCSS modifications should be minimal and targeted.
key_patterns: DM system uses UUID-based room identifiers. Frontend uses Redux-style reducer pattern. Backend uses concerns (DmChatRoomFinder) for shared controller logic. Media attachments linked via DmMessageAttachment join table.
directory_structure: app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/ - frontend DM components, app/controllers/api/v1/dm/ - backend API controllers, app/models/ - ActiveRecord models, app/lib/vacuum/ - cleanup jobs, app/javascript/styles/mastodon/ - SCSS styles
